chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Suleyman ibn Muhammad, from Hariz, from Zurara, who said:

I said to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), 'When shall I exclaim the Talbiyya for the Hajj?' So he (peace be upon him) said: 'When you go out to Mina.' Then he (peace be upon him) said: 'When the Shi'b Dubb is upon your right and Al-Uqba is upon your left, so exclaim the Talbiyya for the Hajj.'
ai.seo_question: When should a Muslim begin reciting the Talbiyya during Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific geographical marker for entering the state of Ihram and commencing the Talbiyya, anchoring the ritual in the topography of Mecca. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on precise adherence to the Prophet's and Imams' instructions regarding the timing of ritual declarations, ensuring the pilgrim's intent is synchronized with the physical journey to Mina.
